description: List the starter games: 180+ ready-made multiplayer games across every genre (the ones built in Multiplayer Agent's videos come first) to begin from with remix_game. Each shows its slug, title, summary, the video it came from if it has one, whether it's premium, and whether THIS studio has it unlocked (free starters: everyone; premium: a paid plan). The full list is long: pass `search` to narrow it when the user named a game or a genre.

search.description: Only starters whose slug, title or summary contains every word here, e.g. 'snake', 'kart', 'trivia'. Leave it out for the whole list.
